---
title: "Headings over tables"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

A heading followed straight by a table is not held by its paragraph: longtable
broke the page after it when the table's header and first rows did not fit,
and the heading sat alone at the foot. Each heading must share its page with
the table's first row.
